common.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
common.errorBody: We could not load this. Please try again.

pray.title: Pray for others
pray.subtitle: Plans other people have shared with you.
pray.empty: Nobody has shared a plan with you yet.
pray.emptyBody: When someone does, it will show up here so you can pray for their day.
pray.planGone: You no longer have access to this plan.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.subtitle: Your language and your account.
profile.name: What we call you
profile.reminderHint: We will use it to remind you once notifications are on.
profile.deleteWarning: Your plans, your circles and everything anyone prayed for you will go. This cannot be undone.
profile.photoTooLarge: That image is too large. Try a smaller one.
profile.photoDenied: We need permission to open your photos.
profile.timezoneHint: It decides when your day opens and when your streak counts.
profile.timezoneMoved: Your device is in {{zone}}. Did you move?
profile.aboutBody: Ammen is an app for praying every day, and for not doing it alone. The plan is written by an AI from what you tell it; the verses come from the Reina-Valera 1909, which is in the public domain.
profile.aboutAi: What the AI writes are suggestions for prayer, not medical, legal or doctrinal advice.
profile.supportHint: If something breaks, tell us along with the version above — it's the first thing we need.
profile.unavailableBody: You may have blocked this person, or their account may no longer exist. Blocks can be undone in “Blocked people”, inside your profile.

auth.passwordTooShort: Your password needs at least 8 characters.
auth.emailTaken: An account with that email already exists.
auth.checkEmail: We sent you an email to confirm your account.
auth.signUpIntro: Join and let others pray with you.
auth.recoverBody: We will send you a link so you can choose a new one.
auth.recoverSentBody: If that address has an account, the link is on its way. Check your email.
auth.recoverExpired: That link is no longer valid. Ask for a new one.
auth.newPasswordBody: You will use it next time you sign in.

onboarding.welcomeBody: A few quick questions so your prayer plan is genuinely yours.
onboarding.seasonQuestion: What are you going through right now?
onboarding.topicsQuestion: What would you like to pray about?
onboarding.minutesQuestion: How long do you want to spend each day?
onboarding.topicsHint: Pick as many as you like.
onboarding.genderHint: So the prayers are written correctly for you.
onboarding.seasonMax: You've picked {{count}}. Remove one to change it.
onboarding.timeHint: You can pick up to {{count}} time of day.
onboarding.customPlaceholder: My sister is ill, a decision about moving…
onboarding.customHint: Optional. It's what makes your plan unlike anyone else's.
onboarding.timeHint_plural: You can pick up to {{count}} times of day.

plan.generatingHint: This can take a minute. You can close the app; it will be waiting here.
plan.noPlanTitle: You don't have a plan yet
plan.noPlanBody: We'll build one for you from what you told us.
plan.failedBody: It happens sometimes. Please try again.
plan.limitTitle: You've used your three free plans
plan.limitBody: With Ammen Plus you can create as many plans as you like.
plan.stillPreparing: We are still preparing the later days.
plan.dayNotFound: That day is not there yet.
plan.finishedIntercessions: And {{count}} time someone prayed for you.
plan.finishedIntercessions_plural: And {{count}} times someone prayed for you.
plan.stalledBody: {{written}} of {{total}} days were written and generation stopped partway.
plan.resumed: We're writing the rest. Check back in a minute.

share.title: Share my plan
share.subtitle: Whoever receives it can pray for you each day.
share.message: I'm praying about {{theme}} for {{days}} days. Will you join me today?
share.previewSignupHint: Ten seconds, and {{name}} will know you prayed.
share.previewNotFound: This link is no longer available.
share.previewNotFoundHint: Whoever shared it may have turned it off.
share.circlesHint: Members will see your day and can pray for you.
share.linkWarning: Anyone with this link can see today, account or not.
share.noLinkHint: You have not created a link for this plan yet.
share.shareFailed: Could not share. Copy the link above by hand.
share.deadLinkInvite: You can create your own and share it with whoever you like.
share.publicOn: Anybody can open this plan from your profile and pray for you.
share.publicOff: This plan is not on your profile or in the community.
share.published: Published. It's on your profile now.
share.unpublished: Done. It's no longer on your profile.
share.stillWritingMinute: We're writing your plan. It usually takes a minute; you can close the app and it will wait for you.

intercession.nobodyYet: Nobody has prayed today yet. Share your plan.
intercession.prayedThanks: Thank you. {{name}} will see it today.
intercession.allPrayedBody: Come back tomorrow, or share your plan so somebody can pray for you.

circles.title: Your circles
circles.subtitle: Family, small group, friends. Who you share your plans with.
circles.empty: You don't have any circles yet.
circles.emptyBody: Create one to share your plans with the people you trust.
circles.name: Name
circles.visibilityPrivateHint: It shows up in no search: the link is the only way in.
circles.visibilityPublicHint: It will show up in searches. Whoever creates it has to moderate it.
circles.shareMessage: I'm inviting you to my prayer circle "{{name}}" on Ammen.
circles.leaveConfirm: Are you sure you want to leave?
circles.joined: You're already part of this circle
circles.inviteNotFound: This invitation is no longer valid.
circles.joinFailed: We could not add you. The invite may no longer be valid.
circles.findNone: There are no public circles yet. Yours could be the first.
circles.planEmptyBody: One walk for everyone, day by day. You create it and the whole circle prays it.
circles.sharedEmpty: No plan is being shared here yet.

feed.title: Prayer requests
feed.subtitle: What people are asking for. Pray, and let them know.
feed.body: What would you like prayer for?
feed.placeholder: My mother goes into surgery tomorrow…
feed.anonymousHint: Nobody will see who wrote it, not even to block you. It can still be reported.
feed.emptyBody: You could be the one to start.
feed.emptyCircle: Nobody has asked for prayer in this circle yet.
feed.wallNoAdmin: Nobody moderates here. If something shouldn't be up, report it or block whoever wrote it.

testimony.title: Answered prayer
testimony.subtitle: What happened while you prayed, and what happened in your circle.
testimony.placeholder: My mother came out of hospital yesterday…
testimony.emptyBody: When something you prayed for is answered, tell it here.
testimony.visPrivateHint: Kept for you. You can share it later.
testimony.visCirclesHint: The people who prayed with you will see it.
testimony.visPublicHint: Anyone using Ammen will be able to read it.
testimony.askAfterPlan: Was anything you asked for answered?
testimony.shareMessage: I prayed about this and I want to tell it: {{body}}

invite.title: Invite someone to pray with you
invite.body: Prayer weighs less when someone carries it with you.
invite.message: I'm using Ammen to pray every day. Want to join?
invite.landing: {{name}} is inviting you to pray on Ammen
invite.landingUnknown: You've been invited to pray on Ammen

paywall.title: Ammen Plus
paywall.subtitle: Unlimited plans, made for what you are going through.
paywall.freeNote: Praying for others and creating circles is free forever.
paywall.freeCircles: Circles, chat, and praying for other people.
paywall.paidPlans: As many plans as you like, not three.
paywall.notYet: You can't subscribe yet. We're working on it, and we'll let you know.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.empty: Nothing here yet. When somebody prays for you, you'll find it here.

newPlan.title: New plan
newPlan.topicQuestion: What do you want to pray about?
newPlan.topicHint: Pick as many as you like.

newPlan.customHint: Optional. This is what will make this plan unlike any other.
newPlan.visPrivateHint: Nobody else will see it. You can share it later.
newPlan.visCirclesHint: Members will be able to pray for you each day.

newPlan.noCircles: You have no circles yet. Create it private and share it later.
newPlan.visPublicHint: It will sit on your profile and in the community. Anybody can open it and pray for you.

bible.title: Bible
bible.subtitle: Reina-Valera 1909
bible.searchPlaceholder: Search a word or a reference

chat.title: Chat
chat.empty: No messages yet. Write the first one.
chat.messageActions: Message from {{name}}. Tap to report or block.

moderation.blockDone: Blocked. You won't see this person again.
moderation.reportDone: Thank you. We'll look into it.
moderation.hideDone: Message hidden for the whole circle.
moderation.blockedHint: You won't see their messages, their plans, or when they pray for you. They are never told.
moderation.heldHint: Somebody will read it before it goes up. It may take a few hours.

community.title: Community
community.nobodyFound: We couldn't find anybody by that name.
community.empty: Nothing here yet. Be the first to ask for prayer.
community.fromEveryone: You don't follow anybody yet, so this is the latest from the community. Follow somebody and you'll see theirs first.

legal.gateBody: Ammen is a place where people write down what they are going through. For it to be a safe place there are some rules, and we want you to know what we do with what you tell us. Read it, and if you're happy, let's go in.
legal.exportHint: A file with everything Ammen keeps about you. It contains what you wrote, anonymous requests included — keep it somewhere safe.

list.title: My prayer list
list.placeholder: My mother, Luis's job, a decision…
list.empty: Your list is empty. Write down who or what you want to pray for these days.
list.howLongHint: You'll pray for {{count}} request, one at a time.
list.howLongHint_plural: You'll pray for {{count}} requests, one at a time.
